import numpy as np
from PIL import Image

im1 = np.array(Image.open('/work/observations/obs_0001.png'))
# Cabinet base in obs1:
# The front panel is white side, brown doors
# Let's find the bottom edge of the cabinet where it touches the floor
# Cabinet is in range u in [280, 360], v in [340, 420]
# Let's inspect rows around v=350 to 420
for v in range(350, 420, 5):
    row_colors = [im1[v, u] for u in range(290, 360, 10)]
    # print max/min RGB
    # print(v, row_colors)

# Specifically find where the cabinet meets the floor
# Floor color is around [160, 155, 145]
# Cabinet white panel is > 180, brown panel is ~ [140, 115, 90]
mask_cab = ((im1[:,:,0] > 180) & (im1[:,:,1] > 180) & (im1[:,:,2] > 180)) | ((im1[:,:,0] > 120) & (im1[:,:,0] < 160) & (im1[:,:,1] > 95) & (im1[:,:,1] < 135) & (im1[:,:,2] < 110))
coords = np.argwhere(mask_cab)
cab_coords = coords[(coords[:,1] >= 290) & (coords[:,1] <= 360) & (coords[:,0] > 290)]
import pandas as pd
df = pd.DataFrame(cab_coords, columns=['v', 'u'])
bottoms = df.groupby('u')['v'].max()
print('obs1 cabinet bottom min u:', df['u'].min(), 'max u:', df['u'].max())
print('obs1 cabinet bottom edge: min v=', bottoms.min(), 'max v=', bottoms.max())
print('obs1 bottoms summary:')
print(bottoms.iloc[[0, len(bottoms)//2, -1]])
